subject: Re: Discovery - Private/VPC Architecture Review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Stone <evan.stone@finco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Discovery - private deployment needs

Hi Evan / FinCo team,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation and really helpful context on your regulatory requirements and the expected throughput for the inference layer. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Key needs: private deployment in VPC, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained for 7+ years, strict egress controls.
- Workloads: initial pilot (10 QPS, 4 vCPU-ish model), expected ramp to 100 QPS in 9-12 months.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms P95 for common inference paths, SOC2 evidence, and a plan for key rotation & audit.

Next step: We'd like to schedule a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep dive to walk through network topology, KMS integration, and deployment options (VPC peering vs. private link vs. on-prem option). Logan (SE) will lead the technical review. Vivek (AE) will join for contract/timing questions.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 9/22 10:00-11:00am
- Wed 9/23 2:00-3:00pm
- Thu 9/24 9:00-10:00am

I've attached a preliminary mutual action plan and a draft private VPC diagram to help guide the discussion. Please let me know which slot works or propose a couple alternatives and who will join from your side.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: FinCo_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, redwood-private-vpc-draft.pdf

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap.

All of that looks right. We're definitely interested in the architecture review. A few notes from our side:
- We'd like the call to include someone on our network team (I'll invite Priya Nair, our network lead) and our security/compliance partner (Alex Brooks).
- The preferred times for our team are Wed 9/23 after 1pm or Thu 9/24 morning.
- If possible, we want to review the draft VPC diagram beforehand and have Logan call out where audit logs and KMS calls would terminate.

Can you loop in the SE and confirm final time? I'll wait for the calendar invite.

Best,

Hi Evan - looping in Logan (SE) and Vivek.

Logan - Evan will bring Priya (network lead) and Alex (security). They prefer Wed 9/23 after 1pm or Thu 9/24 morning. Can you confirm which of the slots below work for you and whether 60 minutes is sufficient? Proposed agenda is below.

Proposed final slots (PST):
- Wed 9/23 2:00-3:00pm (preferred by FinCo)
- Thu 9/24 9:00-10:00am

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions & goals (5 min)
2) Network topology options (VPC peering / Private Link / On-prem) (20 min)
3) KMS & key rotation options (10 min)
4) Audit logs / retention / compliance (10 min)
5) Rollout plan & next steps (10 min)

Attachments re-attached. Logan, would you be able to call out the specific network/peering requirements and any firewall/NAT considerations? Also, confirm if you need additional pre-meeting artifacts (e.g., sample security questionnaire answers).

Thanks - once we have confirmation I'll send a calendar invite and include the Doc link for the draft diagram.

--
Marissa

Thanks for the loop-in, Marissa.

Wed 9/23 2:00-3:00pm PST works for me. 60 minutes should be fine for the proposed agenda. I'll prepare:
- A clear VPC topology comparison slide (peering vs Private Link vs dedicated interconnect)
- KMS integration patterns (customer-managed keys, HSM support, rotation cadence)
- Audit log flow and retention options across our control plane and customer storage

If you can share any network CIDR ranges or firewall constraints ahead of time that would be helpful, but not required. Also let me know if Alex wants to deep-dive into any specific compliance artifacts - I can bring sample SOC2 controls mapping.

I'll accept the invite once Marissa sends it.
